verses.en: O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
verses.sm: Atua e tagata uma lava O le salamo. Ia outou pepese atu i le ALII i le pese fou; aua o vavega na na faia; o lona aao taumatau,

verses.en: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.sm: o lona lava aao paia, ua ia fai ai le olataga. Ua faailoa mai e le ALII o lana lava faaolataga; ua ia faaalia lana amiotonu i luma o nuu ese.

verses.en: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
verses.sm: Na ia manatua lona alofa ma lona faamaoni i le aiga o Isaraelu; ua iloa e tulu‘iga uma o le lalolagi le olataga mai lo tatou Atua.

verses.en: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.sm: la alalaga i le An le lalolagi uma; ia leo tele lava, ma ia alalaga fiafia, ma ia fai pesega.

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.sm: la outou fai pesega i le ALII i le kitara; o le kitara ma le leo o le pese.

verses.en: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
verses.sm: O pu ma le leo o le sofao ia outou alalaga ai i luma o le ALI le Tupu.

verses.en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.sm: Ia taalili le sami atoa ma mea ua tumu ai, o le atu laulau atoa ma e o nonofo ai.

verses.en: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.sm: Ia pati lima vaitafe, ia alalaga faatasi ai mauga ma le fiafia,

verses.en: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.sm: i luma > le ALII; aua o loo afio mai o ia e faamasino le lalolagi; na te faamasino le atu laulau ma le amiotonu, atoa ma nuu i le tonu.
